A NOTE ON THE NUMBERS

Official statistics is the default view: destination-reported immigration by previous residence, then origin-reported emigration by next residence. Missing official figures stay unavailable; partial coverage is labelled. Choose Best available comparison to include FLOW estimates for gaps, or FLOW model only to compare the model. Official figures may themselves be estimated or provisional, with source flags retained. Dated official residence figures are shown prominently where available, separately from arrivals. Residence stocks, permits and visas are never added to migration-flow totals. Use Country coverage & sources to check imported coverage and remaining gaps. Eurostat migration metadata ↗ Multi-year flows can include repeat migrants. Historical context does not attribute migration counts to a cause.
